name: AST Grep
description: Structural code search using the ast-grep CLI, inspired by Oh My Pi's ast_grep tool.

tools.name: ast_grep
tools.title: AST Grep
tools.description: Search code with ast-grep structural patterns. Use when regex search is too imprecise for syntax-aware code queries.

pattern.description: ast-grep pattern, e.g. console.log($$$), import { $$$IMPORTS } from "react".

paths.description: Files or directories to search. Defaults to current workspace.

lang.description: Optional ast-grep language override, e.g. typescript, tsx, python, rust.

glob.description: Optional glob filter relative to searched paths, e.g. **/*.ts.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Default 50, max 200.

promptGuidelines: Use for syntax-aware searches like calls, imports, declarations, and code shapes; use regular grep/search for plain text.
